method: Direct visual inspection of three repaired source images against original and repair briefs. Independent scores use the unchanged 100-point still-image rubric.
scope: Finished illustrative key art for gallery publication; no orthographic scale, animation or gameplay claims.

images.decision: Accept as finished boss key art.
observed_improvements: Blunt crushing ridges and shortened shovel skull materially distinguish the mouth from the previous ordinary crocodile design.
The slab-breaking action is more central and readable.
Three near-side load-bearing limbs remain separately readable with convincing ground contact.
limits: The masonry slab occludes portions of the lower grinder, so this is not a complete anatomical reference for its paired articulation.
All six limb attachments remain partly occluded by the intended three-quarter view.

images.decision: Accept as finished boss key art; retain 3.2 metres as an authored specification rather than a measured claim about this perspective rendering.
observed_improvements: Both feet sets share a visible landing, removing the building-sized giant impression.
The horizontal third blade and extended hand provide a clear directional attack cue.
All three blades fit within the frame, while adult facial and material treatment remains intact.
limits: Projected head-to-foot heights are roughly 1.3:1, not the nominal 1.8:1 body-height ratio. Camera depth can affect this, but precise 3.2-metre fidelity cannot be verified from the still.
The layered garment remains more patterned than the severe plain-silk brief; this does not undermine adult cinematic quality.

images.decision: Accept as finished dungeon cinematic and luminous-wonder benchmark.
observed_improvements: Blue-green veiling and reduced distant contrast establish a substantially more convincing flooded volume.
Fish distributed through depth and subdued upper architecture strengthen aquatic scale.
The guide ropes, broken central crossing and distant destinations remain legible after atmospheric correction.
limits: Lighting remains a cinematic interpretation, not a physically validated underwater simulation.
A full-frame or carefully selected mobile presentation is needed to retain route narrative.

conclusion: No remaining blocker for the requested finished individual-image gallery. Corrections improve defining anatomy, encounter intention and underwater atmosphere without losing adult treatment. Do not describe b17 as a dimensionally exact reference, or any of these images as validated gameplay or rig assets.
provenance_note: Source filenames and repair briefs inspected. Provenance score remains 4/5 until integrated manifest verification.
